gates.D0_sample: discovery: at least 40 trades (positions: a fresh entry with its cost-free continuations) under the primary rule; else INCONCLUSIVE
gates.D1_account: discovery account ends above its start and its P&L without the 5 largest winning positions is > 0
gates.D2_net: discovery mean net position return (its P&L over the notional it opened with) > 0 and its bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound > 0, clustering positions by the calendar month of their entry
gates.D3_drawdown: discovery daily marked-to-market maximum drawdown shallower than -35%
gates.D4_stress: discovery account ends above its start with doubled costs (S1) and with a two-session lag (S2)
gates.D5_not_brittle: discovery account ends above its start with entry thresholds 0.05 (N1) and 0.15 (N2)
gates.D6_years: the primary discovery account rises in at least 6 of the 10 calendar years 2006-2015
gates.validation: computed only if D0-D6 all pass (otherwise the verdict is FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE if D0 fails, and validation is never computed): V1 account ends above start; V2 mean net position return > 0; V3 daily maximum drawdown shallower than -35%; V4 account ends above start with doubled costs
gates.verdict: FAIL if any D gate fails (INCONCLUSIVE if D0 fails); CONFIRMED if D0-D6 and V1-V4 pass; NOT_CONFIRMED if discovery passes and validation does not. CONFIRMED licenses only a prospective paper log and asking the owner whether to spend the sealed 2024-2026 holdout; never a live order. One run.
